description: Our team is a group of passionate individuals who collaborated to develop MissionCraft – Space Mission Design Game. By combining our creativity, technical knowledge, and problem-solving skills, we created an interactive platform that simulates real-world space mission planning. Our goal is to make spacecraft design, subsystem selection, and mission management engaging and educational while encouraging users to think like space engineers.
summary:
MissionCraft: Space Mission Design Game is an interactive educational platform that allows users to experience the challenges of planning and designing space missions. Users can select spacecraft components, configure subsystems, manage mission budgets, and validate their designs based on mission requirements. The project simulates important aspects of real-world space engineering, including payload selection, propulsion, power systems, communication, and spacecraft performance.

MissionCraft addresses the challenge of making complex space mission concepts easier to understand through hands-on interaction and simulation. It encourages users to make engineering decisions, solve design challenges, and understand how different spacecraft systems work together. This project is important because it makes space exploration more accessible, promotes STEM learning, and inspires users to explore the exciting field of aerospace engineering.
details:
MissionCraft is an interactive Space Mission Design Game that allows users to experience the process of planning and designing space missions. Users can choose missions, select spacecraft components, configure subsystems, manage budgets, and validate their spacecraft designs based on mission requirements. The platform provides real-time engineering feedback, helping users understand how different components affect spacecraft mass, power consumption, fuel, cost, and performance.

The project makes complex aerospace concepts easier to understand through interactive learning and practical decision-making. It encourages creativity, critical thinking, and problem-solving while introducing users to spacecraft engineering and mission planning.

We developed the project using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Vite, with AI-assisted development through Google Antigravity. GitHub was used for version control and Vercel for deployment.

The creative aspect of MissionCraft is its game-based approach to space engineering. Instead of only learning theory, users can experiment with different hardware combinations, work within mission budgets, identify design errors, and improve their spacecraft configurations.

Our team considered mission objectives, hardware compatibility, payload requirements, power and fuel needs, spacecraft mass, communication, thermal control, and budget limitations while developing the project.

Our intended impact is to make space science and engineering more accessible, engaging, and educational, inspiring students and beginners to explore aerospace technology and space exploration.
